note: HQ.3: events live in the interface (zora-protocol's shape). An emit of an event the emitting contract does not declare binds the event its base or the named type declares, never an EVENT_FLOWS edge to an id no node has. Cells not claimed: solidity/eventbus is graded by solidity-event_flows. Emits inside a constructor are not read (a recall gap), so the local control emits from a function.

expect_edges.note: positive control: emit Opened(..) of the contract's own event, the parser's direct edge
emit Signed(..) inherited from IGuestbook through `contract Guestbook is IGuestbook` (graph:solidity inherited_event_by_name: the heritage edge binds by unique name)
emit IGuestbook.Cleared(..), qualified through the base (qualified_event_by_name)
emit IGuestbook.Signed(..) from a test contract with no heritage: the type by its unique name (qualified_event_by_name)

forbid.note: the id the parser guessed before HQ.3 (no node carries it); a guard should a node ever be minted there
